review.accepted_claim: In the registered deterministic individual-specialist Field skill/practice substrate, a public Capability Artifact describing the developmental ecology, substrate law, feedback/development protocol, resource/stopping contract, and behavioral target can be used to reproduce the developed specialist capability in fresh Fields without transferring source-private capability state. This effect was supported in D1 and reproduced prospectively in a fresh D1b cohort under the same conventional 90% fidelity criterion.

checks.reason: D1 confirmatory plan SHA-256 and apparatus lock were frozen and posted on #160 before any confirmatory pair executed (comment 5300263690). D1b plan and lock were frozen on #163 before any D1b pair executed (comment 5300319188). Both record zero confirmatory outcomes at lock time.

D1b explicitly reused the exact D1 scientific runner/evaluator hashes, same ecology, same Capability Artifact schema, same P0→P1→P2 analysis, same bootstrap implementation, and same conventional P2 NI margin. No scientific field was tuned from D1 outcomes.

D1-0 development seeds 10000..10063, D1 confirmatory seeds 30000..30035, and D1b seeds 50000..50035 are pairwise disjoint. Audit files confirm no seed overlap. All source/destination identities are disjoint within each pair.

D1: P0 estimate +0.5836, P1 +0.6002, P2 +0.0166; all normal and bootstrap one-sided lower bounds exceed their registered null boundaries. D1b: P0 +0.6038, P1 +0.5949, P2 −0.0089; P2 lower bounds −0.0242/−0.0244 exceed conventional NI boundary −0.0593. All gates passed in both studies.
Both D1 and D1b explicitly classify the P2 margin as 'conventional' with provenance from the 90% product-fidelity convention fixed before D1 execution. Neither study treats it as derived materiality.

Audit records for all 72 Field pairs show leaked_forbidden_fields empty, private_state_transfer_allowed false, source_identity_present false. Deterministic source seeds are classified as reconstructive private information and excluded from the artifact.
Both studies report private-state oracle as diagnostic and product-ineligible (gate_8 true). By-skill decompositions are labeled descriptive only and cannot rescue a failed pooled primary gate.

Both studies explicitly restrict claim ceiling to 'controlled_deterministic_individual_specialist_substrate_only' and disclaim stochastic learning, semantic transfer, team/institution reproduction, naturalistic transfer, and environment spawning.

Both result files record production_historical_substrate_enabled: false and gate_10_production_historical_substrate_off: true. Result documents explicitly state Production/default Historical Substrate remains OFF.

D1 preservation commit af39e10a recorded on PR #162. D1b explicitly parents from that D1 preservation commit and records its own preservation commit ce02a762 on PR #164, stacked on D1 PR #162. Dependency chain is intact.

Issue #165 rubric explicitly requires proposer_id != acceptor_id. The D1/D1b proposer is user Alajmah (issue author on #160, #163). This review is issued by Z.AI/glm-5-turbo as independent_acceptance_plane_reviewer, satisfying the constitutional separation.
